# HEM v0.8.1b1 — Connected room tabs

A beta visual refinement of the v0.8.0 two-row room overview, following the approved preview.

- Removes the surrounding dark frame above the room title.
- Gives the room-name/settings tab and the readings below one connected outline: the same surface background and no dividing seam under the tab.
- Keeps the green accent at the top of the tab and honours the existing warning border colour.
- Continues the outline around an expanded room without changing room contents or controls.
- Preserves responsive sensor chips, keyboard room folding, per-room settings and floor grouping.
- Adds mobile and desktop Chromium layout assertions for the shared surface and seamless border.
- Loads the small styling addition as a versioned HEM frontend resource, with cleanup on integration removal.

Install from HACS with beta releases enabled, restart Home Assistant, and hard-refresh the dashboard.
